chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot to shorten his hair while he was a pilgrim, until he departed from Mina. He (peace be upon him) said: 'I do not like that he cast off his hair except in Mina.'

And he (peace be upon him) said regarding the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Then let them fulfill their needful acts (tafathahum).' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is the shaving and what is in the skin of the human being.'

key_terms.تَفَثَهُمْ: Needful acts/ritual grooming (specifically shaving hair and cutting nails)
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a sacred site near Mecca where pilgrims perform specific rituals

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim who forgot to shave or cut their hair before leaving Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the procedural timing for completing the ritual grooming (tafath) when a pilgrim neglects it before departing Mina, emphasizing that the act of casting off hair must be performed within the Mina precincts. The Imam further elucidates the Quranic term 'tafath' to encompass both head shaving and the removal of bodily impurities, reflecting the Shia scholarly understanding of purification rites. This ruling underscores the importance of adhering to specific geographic boundaries for Hajj rituals as derived from the Imams' interpretation of the Quran.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Al Sabbah Al Kinany who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a man who forgot to do Taqseer, and he was a pilgrim of Hajj until he departed from Mina. Heasws said: ‘It does not please measws if he were to throw off his hair except in Mina’.
And heasws said regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [22:29] Then let them fulfill their needful acts. Heasws said: ‘It is the shaving and what is in the skin of the human being’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Sabbah al-Kinaniy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who forgets to do Taqsir (cutting some hair or finger nails and so on) and he is for al-Hajj, until he leaves Mina He (the Imam) said, ’I do not like throwing the hairs in places other than MinaV
About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, . . thereafter they must spruce up themselves . . .’[22:29] he (the Imam) said that it refers to shaving and things on a man’s skin.’”
